entities.summary: Juan Luis Ysern de Arce is a Spanish-born Chilean Roman Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of San Carlos de Ancud in Chile from 1974 until 2005. Following his retirement, he holds the title of Bishop Emeritus of Ancud. He is known for his long episcopal leadership in the Chiloé Archipelago, his advocacy for human rights during the Chilean military dictatorship, and his later public interventions concerning episcopal accountability within the Catholic Church.
